## Summary

Compose A-1 (discovery) + A-2 (context) into the one public function the rest of the system uses: `distillPage(): PageState`. Then keep that state fresh with a debounced `MutationObserver` that also watches **open shadow roots** and reports _what changed_ so the HUD can highlight the delta.

This is the boundary between "stuff in the DOM" and the universal contract — the output must be `PageStateSchema.parse`-clean, every time.

## Public API

```ts
// packages/dom-engine/src/eyes/distill.ts
export interface DistillOptions {
  root?: Document | ShadowRoot;
  maxElements?: number;
  includeValues?: boolean; // default true; false for privacy mode (passwords always redacted)
  debounceMs?: number; // default 250
  observerDebounceMs?: number; // default 120 (separate, tighter, for the watcher)
}

export function distillPage(options?: DistillOptions): PageState;

export interface StateChange {
  pageState: PageState;
  added: string[]; // vfeIds newly present
  removed: string[]; // vfeIds that disappeared
  updated: string[]; // vfeIds whose serialised value/error changed
  reason: 'mutation' | 'manual';
}

export interface PageWatcher {
  start(): void;
  stop(): void;
  /** Force an immediate re-scan and emit. */
  refresh(): StateChange;
  /** Latest snapshot without re-scanning. */
  current(): PageState | null;
}

export function watchPage(
  onChange: (change: StateChange) => void,
  options?: DistillOptions,
): PageWatcher;

export function serializeElement(el: HTMLElement, vfeId: string, badgeIndex: number): FormElement;
```

## Serialisation rules (map DOM → `FormElementSchema`)

| Field             | Rule                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`              | `data-vfe-id` (from A-1). Never a raw DOM id.                                                                                                                                             |
| `badgeIndex`      | Position in the ordered discovery result, `1..N`.                                                                                                                                         |
| `type`            | Mapping table below.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `label`           | A-2 `ResolvedContext.label` (non-empty).                                                                                                                                                  |
| `placeholder`     | `placeholder` attr, trimmed, omitted if empty.                                                                                                                                            |
| `value`           | Per type — see "Value serialisation".                                                                                                                                                     |
| `options`         | `select` → all `<option>` (label = text, value = `option.value`); `combobox` → `[]` when closed, populated from visible `[role=option]` when open. `checkbox`/`radio`/`button` → omitted. |
| `required`        | A-2 `required`.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `disabled`        | `el.disabled === true` **or** `aria-disabled="true"` **or** inside a disabled `<fieldset>`.                                                                                               |
| `focused`         | `el.getRootNode().activeElement === el` **or** `el === document.activeElement` (handles shadow roots).                                                                                    |
| `validationError` | A-2 `validationError` (omitted if undefined).                                                                                                                                             |
| `groupLabel`      | A-2 `groupLabel` (omitted if undefined).                                                                                                                                                  |

### Type mapping

```ts
function mapType(el: HTMLElement): FormElement['type'] {
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  const role = el.getAttribute('role');
  if (tag === 'textarea') return 'textarea';
  if (tag === 'select') return 'select';
  if (tag === 'button' || role === 'button') return 'button';
  if (tag === 'input') {
    const t = (el as HTMLInputElement).type;
    if (t === 'checkbox') return 'checkbox';
    if (t === 'radio') return 'radio';
    if (t === 'email') return 'email';
    if (t === 'number') return 'number';
    if (t === 'tel') return 'tel';
    if (t === 'date') return 'date';
    if (t === 'password') return 'password';
    return 'text'; // text, search, url, month, week, time, datetime-local, color, range
  }
  if (role === 'combobox') return 'combobox';
  if (role === 'checkbox') return 'checkbox';
  if (role === 'switch') return 'checkbox';
  if (role === 'radio') return 'radio';
  if (role === 'listbox') return 'combobox'; // collapsed custom select
  if (role === 'textbox' || el.isContentEditable) return 'text';
  return 'text';
}
```

`role="option"` elements serialise as `type: 'text'` with `groupLabel` = the listbox label — they are click targets, and `CLICK` is the action (B-2).

### Value serialisation

```ts
function readValue(el: HTMLElement, type: FormElement['type']): FormElement['value'] {
  switch (type) {
    case 'checkbox':
      return (el as HTMLInputElement).checked ?? el.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true';
    case 'select': {
      const s = el as HTMLSelectElement;
      return s.multiple ? Array.from(s.selectedOptions, (o) => o.value) : s.value;
    }
    case 'radio':
      return (el as HTMLInputElement).checked ? (el as HTMLInputElement).value : false;
    case 'button':
      return ''; // buttons have no value; never leak the label as value
    default:
      if (el.isContentEditable) return (el.innerText ?? '').trim();
      return (el as HTMLInputElement).value ?? '';
  }
}
```

Hard rules:

- **`password` values are never serialised.** Always `'<redacted>'` when `value` is non-empty, `''` when empty. The user's secret never leaves the page. Add a test that greps the serialised JSON for the fixture password.
- Radio `value` semantics: `true` when checked, `false` when not — plus A-3 sets `value: true` only for the checked member of the group. (The checked member's `value` is `true`; siblings are `false`.) This lets the Brain answer "is shipping set to Express?".
- Never include `value` for `button`/`submit` — they would confuse the model into echoing text back.
- Numbers stay strings (the DOM has no number type). The Brain formats; B-1 sets.

### `globalErrors`

Collected in one pass over the page (not per element):

- nodes with `role="alert"` at page level (outside any field wrapper) and visible text;
- `[aria-live="assertive"]` containers with text;
- elements with class matching `/(error|alert|danger|toast)/i` inside a `<form>` whose text `< 300` chars and which are visible, deduped, max 5 entries.

### Page title

```ts
function pageTitle(): string {
  const og = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]')?.getAttribute('content');
  return (document.title || og || location.pathname).slice(0, 200);
}
```

## Mutation watcher specification

The watcher must be **cheap, quiet, and shadow-aware**.

1. **Observe roots:** the document (`childList`, `subtree`, `attributes`, `characterData`) **and** every open shadow root found during the last discovery. Re-scan for new shadow hosts on each pass (hosts appear dynamically).
2. **Attribute filter:** `['data-vfe-id', 'aria-hidden', 'aria-invalid', 'aria-expanded', 'disabled', 'value', 'class', 'style', 'hidden', 'role', 'aria-checked', 'aria-label', 'placeholder', 'type', 'required']`. `class`/`style` are needed for visibility changes but are the noisiest — hence the debounce.
3. **Ignore our own writes:** every tag write sets a module flag `isSelfMutation = true` around the DOM write batch (synchronous), and the observer callback runs in a microtask — so instead compare: if the only mutations are `data-vfe-*` attribute changes, drop the batch. Never call `distillPage()` from inside the observer callback synchronously.
4. **Debounce:** trailing debounce, default `120 ms`, hard max wait `500 ms` (`maxWait` semantics like lodash debounce) so a page animating constantly still refreshes twice a second at worst.
5. **Change detection:** re-distill, then diff against the previous snapshot by `vfeId`:
   - `added` = ids present now and not before;
   - `removed` = ids before and not now;
   - `updated` = ids in both whose `value`, `checked`, `validationError`, `disabled`, `options.length`, or `focused` changed (deep-compare a compact per-element fingerprint).
6. If nothing changed, **do not** call `onChange` (prevents HUD thrash and redundant LLM context).
7. `stop()` disconnects all observers and clears timers; `start()` is idempotent.
8. `refresh()` bypasses the debounce and emits `reason: 'manual'`.

### React/SPA caveat

React re-renders replace nodes rather than mutating them; the `WeakMap` identity cache then yields **new** ids for what the user perceives as the same field. Mitigation (mandatory):

- On each pass, attempt **id re-adoption**: if a newly-discovered element has the same `name` + `type` + resolved `label` + `groupLabel` as a previously disappeared element, reuse that element's old `vfeId` (keep a `Map<fingerprint, vfeId>` with a 60 s TTL). This keeps badge numbers and Brain references stable across re-renders.
- Test with the testbed's "React re-render" route that swaps the whole form on every keystroke.

## Performance budget

| Page size                      | Budget                           |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| 50 controls                    | ≤ 12 ms                          |
| 250 controls                   | ≤ 40 ms                          |
| Mutation burst (10 DOM writes) | 1 re-distill, ≤ 60 ms, debounced |

Also: coalesce with `requestIdleCallback` when the page is not focused? **No** — an unfocused page still needs a fresh snapshot when the user speaks again. Keep it simple.

### Unit (jsdom)

| Test                    | Assertion                                                                            |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `distill-basic`         | Valid `PageStateSchema.parse()` output; element count matches A-1                    |
| `distill-types`         | All 12 protocol types produced from a kitchen-sink fixture                           |
| `password-redaction`    | `value === '<redacted>'`, and `JSON.stringify(state)` does not contain `hunter2`     |
| `checkbox-radio-values` | booleans + checked-radio semantics                                                   |
| `select-options`        | options with label/value; multiple → array of values                                 |
| `combobox-closed-open`  | `options: []` closed; populated when `aria-expanded=true` with visible options       |
| `focused-shadow`        | focused input inside shadow root reports `focused: true`                             |
| `global-errors`         | page-level alert text captured, field errors not duplicated into it                  |
| `watch-appends-input`   | appending an input fires `onChange` within `debounceMs + 60` with `added: ['vfe_N']` |
| `watch-no-change`       | a no-op mutation does not fire                                                       |
| `watch-self-tagging`    | tagging pass itself never triggers a callback (loop guard)                           |
| `watch-removed`         | removing a field reports `removed`                                                   |
| `watch-updated-value`   | programmatic value change + `change` event reports `updated`                         |
| `watch-max-wait`        | continuous mutations still emit at least every 500 ms                                |
| `id-readoption`         | React-style node replacement preserves `vfeId`                                       |
| `stop-cleanup`          | after `stop()`, mutations never fire; no timers left (fake timers assert)            |

### Browser (Playwright)

- Real page with a `<dialog>` opened after 200 ms: watcher emits with the modal's fields.
- Scroll + resize do not emit spurious changes.
- 500-input stress: distill ≤ 40 ms ×3 CI multiplier; watcher does not exceed 1 emit per 100 ms during typing simulation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `distillPage()` returns an object that passes `PageStateSchema.parse()` for every fixture (assert via real `parse`, not just a type).
- [ ] Appending an `<input>` dynamically fires `onStateChange` within 250 ms with updated JSON.
- [ ] Password values never appear in emitted state (verified by string search).
- [ ] Watcher never fires from its own `data-vfe-*` writes (no feedback loop; test with a mutation counter).
- [ ] `added` / `removed` / `updated` diffs are exact (no false positives on identical re-scans).
- [ ] React node replacement preserves `vfeId` for the same logical field.
- [ ] `stop()` fully disconnects; no pending timers; no memory growth after 100 start/stop cycles (heap smoke test).
- [ ] Performance budgets met (jsdom for logic, Playwright for real layout).
- [ ] Shadow-root mutations are observed (input added inside an open shadow root triggers a refresh).
- [ ] Exported from `@vfe/dom-engine`: `distillPage`, `watchPage`, `serializeElement`, types `DistillOptions`, `StateChange`, `PageWatcher`.

## Non-goals

- Sending state anywhere (that's INT-1).
- Deciding _which_ fields matter (the Brain does).
- Persisting state across page loads.
- Watching closed shadow roots (impossible) or iframes.

## Definition of done

- The extension content script only ever calls these three functions (`distillPage`, `watchPage`, and later `executeActions`) — no duplicated DOM logic in `packages/extension`.
- README documents the privacy redaction rule prominently.
